name: tpl-precedence-3-nogoal
task: Do not take the key until you have moved the ball away from the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task is a restriction, not a command. Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) forbids taking the key before moving the ball, and the hard Absence(key_lost) additionally forbids losing the key while the door is still closed (which is exactly 'lost before the blocker was moved' under the environment's definitions). Taking the key is only restricted, never commanded, so the rule-only warning with empty FINAL_STATES is valid.

texts: Only take the key after the blocker has been moved.
Do not take the key before the blocker has been moved.
